column1: # Branded consensus (branded-consensus/2): the contents of generic curated made products from the ingredient statements of their US branded products in FoodData Central (FoodData_Central_branded_food_csv_2025-12-18, public domain), derived by Nom.Import --branded-consensus, never edited by hand.

# products: the matched products whose statement was read; stating: those that state the class (the gate's reading of the statement against the default criteria of the class's type, warnings left out); examples: up to three FDC ids that state it.
# verdict: usually when at least 0.75 of at least 10 products state it, split when more than 0.1 and less than that; a food or class with no row reads as its own data.
